entries.label: Aluminium - Stamp Supercharger
cells: Stamp Doublers give an extra +1% MORE bonus than the normal +100% they give!

entries.label: Beryllium - Post Office Penner
cells: Every day, 1 silver pen from your Post Office will instantly convert into 1 PO Box for all characters. This conversion happens 7 times per day.

entries.label: Boron - Particle Upgrader
cells: When a bubble has a cost of 100M or more to upgrade, you can instead spend particles. However, you can only do this 2 times a day, after which the cost will return to resources.

entries.label: Carbon - Wizard Maximizer
cells: All wizard towers in construction get +2 max levels. Also, all wizards get a +2% damage bonus for each wizard tower level above 50 in construction.

entries.label: Chlorine - Lumi Gainer
cells: Boosts your hourly Lumi Gain over at the Luminous Menagerie by +2%! This is NOT a new multiplier, you'll have to live with an additive atom bonus, womp womp.

entries.label: Fluoride - Void Plate Chef
cells: Multiplies your cooking speed by +1% for every meal at Lv 30+. In other words, every plate with a studded black void plate.

entries.label: Helium - Talent Power Stacker
cells: All talents that give more bonus per 'Power of 10 resources you own' will count +1 more powers of 10 than you actually own when giving the bonus.

entries.label: Hydrogen - Stamp Decreaser
cells: Every day you log in, the resource cost to upgrade a stamp's max lv decreases by 1% up to a max of 90%. This reduction resets back to 0% when upgrading any stamp max lv.

entries.label: Lithium - Bubble Insta Expander
cells: No Bubble Left Behind bonus now has a 15% chance to level up the lowest bubble out of ALL bubbles, not just the first 15 of each colour. Also, +1% chance to give +1 additional Lv.

entries.label: Magnesium - Trap Compounder
cells: Every day, critters gained from traps increases by +1%. This bonus is capped at 60 days, and resets back to +0% when a new trap is placed.

entries.label: Neon - Damage N' Cheapener
cells: Increases your total damage by +1%. Also, reduces the cost of all atom upgrades by 1% too.

entries.label: Nitrogen - Construction Trimmer
cells: Gold trimmed construction slots give +15% more build rate than before. Also, you now have 1 additional trimmed slot.

entries.label: Oxygen - Library Booker
cells: Increases the Checkout Refresh Speed of the Talent Library by +2%. Also, the Minimum Talent LV is increased by +1, and the Maximum Talent LV is increased by +10.

entries.label: Phosphorus - Sushi Bucks Generator
cells: Boosts your Sushi Station Bucks gain by +1%! This is a new multiplier, so it's always relevant!

entries.label: Silicon - Minehead Currency Printer
cells: Boosts your Minehead Currency gain by +1%! This is a new multiplier, so it's always relevant!

entries.label: Sodium - Snail Kryptonite
cells: When you fail a snail upgrade, it's LV gets reset to the nearest 5 (Up to Lv 5) instead of back to 0, like failing at Lv 7 will reset to Lv 5.

entries.label: Sulfur - Jelly Bloodcell Juicer
cells: Boosts your Jelly Operator Bloodcell gain by +1%! Can you guess whether this is a new multiplier? I'll give you a hint, it's always relevant...
